title: Bogor Palace

terrainReference.basis: Original source garden grade outside the south garden steps. Stair levels and precise foundation datums are estimated.

mapIdentity.scope: The exact native ring spans approximately 216 by 78 metres and controls the central block, projecting north and south frontages, lateral galleries and end pavilions.

note: Verified standing exterior shows white Corinthian-style columns, two principal roof heights, a pinkish terracotta tile roof and gold-colored shallow dome over a white lantern.
